description: This file contains abstract base class for membership table tests in Orleans, along with some test constants and utility methods. It defines test setup, teardown, and various test helper methods for managing membership entries, verifying table states, and interacting with the membership table subsystem.

classes.name: SiloInstanceTableTestConstants
classes.description: Contains static readonly constants used for membership table test configurations, including timeouts and status strings.

classes.name: MembershipTableTestsBase
classes.description: Abstract base class for Orleans membership table testing, providing setup, utility methods, and test procedures for derived test classes.

methods.name: MembershipTable_GetGateways
methods.description: Tests reading and writing membership entries and verifying gateway list provisioning.

methods.name: MembershipTable_ReadAll_EmptyTable
methods.description: Verifies that reading all membership data from an empty table returns appropriate empty data.

methods.name: MembershipTable_InsertRow
methods.description: Tests inserting a membership entry into the table.

methods.name: MembershipTable_ReadRow_Insert_Read
methods.description: Performs insert and read operations to verify correct behavior with membership entries.

methods.name: MembershipTable_ReadAll_Insert_ReadAll
methods.description: Validates reading all entries after insert operations.

methods.name: MembershipTable_UpdateRow
methods.description: Checks updating membership entries and related version control.

methods.name: MembershipTable_UpdateRowInParallel
methods.description: Tests concurrent updates to membership entries.

methods.name: MembershipTable_UpdateIAmAlive
methods.description: Tests updating the IAmAlive timestamp for a membership entry.

methods.name: MembershipTable_CleanupDefunctSiloEntries
methods.description: Removes entries deemed defunct based on IAmAliveTime and verifies cleanup.

methods.name: CreateMembershipEntryForTest
methods.description: Utility to create a test membership entry.

methods.name: GetUtcNowWithSecondsResolution
methods.description: Utility to get current UTC time truncated to seconds.

methods.name: CreateSiloAddressForTest
methods.description: Utility to create a test silo address with a unique ID.
